data.body: A6-0a pre-push completion milestone: resumed standard-tier implementation after 2 reported attempts. Five-axis review found that fetch can move a remote-tracking ref outside the store lock between the epoch check and merge, superseding the earlier contention-exemption note. Added a deterministic real-Git RED oracle at both sync and push sites; pre-fix, the different-epoch commit became reachable at both sites. Fixed by pinning the remote commit before checking and merging that exact target, with a fresh pin after stash. The defect-seeded test is GREEN 2/2; complete focused oracle is GREEN 26/26. Final gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, make test PASS (9,884 passed, 34 skipped, 202 deselected, 22 baseline warnings). Local review-code preview is disabled by verify.enable_code_review; direct five-axis review has zero remaining blockers. Signed commit 5b7ed05005, Gerrit change 1351: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1351.
